findings.title: OpenAPI baseline unverified against generated schema
findings.problem: The additive contract fields (turns, agent_count, skill_count, tool_calls_total, summary_state, summary_metrics) were hand-edited into the guarded OpenAPI baseline. The snapshot test could not run on Windows (WinError 10106, no pwd module) and make test-harness was not run (no docker stack), so the baseline is unconfirmed against generated output.
findings.impact: A spec requirement (additive contract) is only partially verified; a baseline mismatch would fail the guarded snapshot test in CI or on a compatible host.
findings.recommendation: Run the guarded OpenAPI snapshot test (and make test-harness if available) on a Linux/compatible host and record the passing result mapped to this finding id; regenerate the baseline if it differs.
